title: Physiological Trajectories and Observation Patterns in ICU Mortality Prediction: Transportability Under Changing Measurement Conditions
abstract: arXiv:2610.42126v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Objective: To distinguish the transferable predictive value of physiological trajectories from that of observation patterns in ICU mortality prediction, and to assess whether measurement timing affects performance independently of observation quantity.   Materials and Methods: In-hospital mortality was predicted at 48 hours using MIMIC-III, MIMIC-IV, and eICU. Nested representations progressively integrated latest-value snapshots (R1), longitudinal physiological summaries (R2), and measurement frequency and timing features (R3). Models fitted on 7,762 MetaVision patients were evaluated on 21,682 MIMIC-IV patients and 43,878 eICU patients across 204 hospitals. The effect of measurement timing was assessed while holding the number of retained observations constant. translated_title: ICU死亡率预测中的生理轨迹与观测模式：测量条件变化下的可迁移性研究
translated_abstract: 目的：区分ICU死亡率预测中生理轨迹与观测模式各自的可迁移预测价值，并评估测量时机是否独立于观测数量对预测性能产生影响。材料与方法：使用MIMIC-III、MIMIC-IV和eICU数据集对48小时内的院内死亡率进行预测。通过嵌套表示逐步整合最新值快照（R1）、纵向生理摘要（R2）以及测量频率与时机特征（R3）。在7,762名MetaVision患者上拟合的模型，在来自204家医院的21,682名MIMIC-IV患者和43,878名eICU患者上进行评估。在保持保留观测数量不变的前提下，评估测量时机的影响。结果：生理轨迹改善了eICU的外部预测效果（R2-R1对数损失差异-0.00922，95% CI -0.01148至-0.00704）。观测模式特征改善……（原文摘要到此截断）
tldr: 该研究通过嵌套表示设计与跨数据库外部验证发现，生理轨迹在ICU死亡率预测中具有跨医院、跨电子病历系统的可迁移预测价值，并独立于观测数量评估了测量时机对性能的影响。
en_tdlr: This study shows that physiological trajectories carry transportable predictive value for ICU mortality prediction across hospital systems and datasets, and assesses the effect of measurement timing on performance independently of observation quantity.
